description:
Compare the drug interaction safety of Sildenafil (Viagra) with two different cancer drugs: Enzalutamide and Imatinib.

1. Open the Liverpool Cancer iChart app.
2. Navigate to 'Enzalutamide' in the cancer drug list.
3. Find 'Sildenafil' (under 'Urologicals', 'Genitourinary', or 'Erectile Dysfunction') and note the interaction traffic-light color.
4. Return to the main menu and navigate to 'Imatinib'.
5. Find 'Sildenafil' again and note the interaction traffic-light color.
6. Create a report file at '/sdcard/sildenafil_comparison.txt' with the format:
   Enzalutamide: [Color]
   Imatinib: [Color]
